_about: SYNTHETIC job rows in the engine's internal schema (scraper.normalize / sources adapters). Invented companies, example.test URLs, a reserved example.com address. Dates are relative ('1 day ago') or far past, so recency is stable over time. '_case' says what each row exercises; the harness strips it before the engine sees the row.

rows._case: strong match; three spellings of one concept (React, React.js, ReactJS) plus Node.js, MongoDB, TypeScript, REST API
rows.Title: React Developer
rows.Description: We build with React, React.js and ReactJS on a Node.js and MongoDB stack. TypeScript preferred. You will design a REST API.

rows._case: React Native inside the text: v1 also counts 'react'; v2's overlap policy counts React Native only
rows.Title: React Native Engineer
rows.Description: React Native developer shipping mobile apps with TypeScript.

rows._case: MERN title (full-stack by title), several concepts, experience floor 2 (inside the candidate limit)
rows.Title: MERN Stack Developer
rows.Description: MongoDB, Express, React and Node.js. 2+ years of experience required.

rows.Title: Full Stack Developer
rows.Description: React and Node.js with a Salesforce integration layer.

rows.Title: Backend Developer
rows.Description: Node.js services alongside a PHP monolith.

rows._case: soft seniority title (senior, -4) with an experience floor of 5 (inside the limit of years+3 = 6)
rows.Title: Senior React Developer
rows.Description: React and TypeScript. 5+ years of experience.

rows._case: hard-drop title (junior is in the rendered exclude_levels)
rows.Title: Junior React Developer
rows.Description: React and Node.js for a small team.

rows._case: 'manager' title: NOT hard-dropped for a generated profile, because exclude_levels replaces config's longer list
rows.Title: Engineering Manager, React
rows.Description: Run a React team. 4+ years of experience.

rows._case: experience floor 8, above the candidate limit of 6: dropped
rows.Title: React Developer II

rows._case: duplicate physical job, copy A: a paid LinkedIn row, thin text
rows.Title: Node.js Developer

rows._case: duplicate physical job, copy B: same company after suffix stripping, same title tokens, richer text; free ATS row
rows.Title: Developer, Node.js

rows._case: remote worldwide: dropped by the India scope's arrangement filter
rows.Title: React Developer (Remote)
rows.Description: Fully remote. We hire worldwide. React and Node.js.

rows._case: onsite abroad: dropped by the India scope's geography filter
rows.Title: React Developer
rows.Description: Onsite in our Berlin office. React.

rows.Title: React Developer

rows.Title: React Developer

rows.Description: React and Node.js. Contact careers@example.com. Must overlap with US Pacific Time (UTC-8).
